label: German cafe
heroTitles: Kaffee Und Kuchen, Just The German Way
Fresh Pretzels And Black Forest Cake Daily
A Little Corner Of Germany For Your Coffee
heroSubtitles: {brand} bakes pretzels and cakes the German way and pours filter coffee all day, in a calm room made for a long chat.
Come for warm apple strudel and a pot of coffee, stay for a slow afternoon. {brand} is a small cafe with a German menu.
From soft pretzels at breakfast to bratwurst at lunch and Black Forest cake after, {brand} keeps a simple German menu.
featureTitle: A German Menu For Every Part Of The Day

features.title: Fresh Pretzels
features.text: Soft salted pretzels baked through the day, served plain, with butter or with mustard.

features.title: Black Forest Cake
features.text: Layers of chocolate sponge, cherries and cream, the classic cake of the Black Forest.

features.title: Apple Strudel
features.text: Thin pastry around spiced apples and raisins, served warm with vanilla sauce.

features.title: Bratwurst And Mustard
features.text: Grilled German sausages with mustard and bread, for a proper lunch at the cafe.

features.title: Filter Coffee
features.text: Freshly brewed filter coffee by the cup or the pot, the German way to start a slow morning.

features.title: Kaffee Und Kuchen
features.text: A pot of coffee and a slice of cake in the afternoon, a German habit we are happy to share.

items.title: Find A Table
items.text: Pick a table inside or by the window, or reserve one for a group.

items.title: Order At The Counter
items.text: Choose pretzels, cake or a hot plate and a pot of coffee.

items.title: Sit And Stay
items.text: Take your time: the coffee comes to the table and refills are easy.

items.title: Take Cake Home
items.text: Ask for a boxed slice or a whole cake to share at home.

faq.q: Do I need to reserve a table?
faq.a: Walk-ins are welcome. For a group or a birthday, message us and we will keep a table ready.
Yes. Pretzels, strudel, cakes and many bakes are vegetarian; ask the team about each dish.
It is a medium roast brewed fresh. Ask for it stronger or lighter and we will adjust.

faq.q: Can I order a whole cake?
faq.a: Yes. Tell us the cake and the day, and we will confirm if it can be ready.
Ask the team which sausages are on the menu today and what they are made of.

about.title: About Our German Cafe
paragraphs: {brand} is a small German cafe that bakes pretzels, strudel and cakes and brews filter coffee all day.
The menu is simple and homely: the cakes and bakes of a German coffee house, served at a pace that lets you stay.
points: A calm room for long chats

testimonials.quote: The pretzels were warm and soft and the cake tasted like it came from a German bakery.
A quiet place for a long coffee and a slice of strudel, easy to spend an afternoon here.
We booked a table for six and the team kept it ready with coffee on arrival.

label: Animal welfare and rescue
heroTitles: Every Street Dog Deserves A Safe Tomorrow
Rescue, Heal And Find A Home
Be The Reason A Stray Gets A Second Chance
heroSubtitles: {brand} rescues injured and abandoned animals, treats them, vaccinates them and finds them loving homes.
Feed, adopt, volunteer or sponsor treatment, because one act of kindness can change an animal's whole life.
{brand} runs a rescue shelter and a street-feeding program, and shares where every donation goes.
featureTitle: How We Help Animals In Need

features.title: Rescue And Ambulance
features.text: Calls about injured or trapped animals are answered by a rescue team.

features.title: Treatment And Surgery
features.text: Wounds, fractures and illness treated by visiting vets, with medicines paid by donors.

features.title: Vaccination And Sterilisation
features.text: Anti-rabies shots and sterilisation drives that keep street animals healthy.

features.title: Feeding Drives
features.text: Daily meals and clean water for street dogs and cats in nearby lanes.

features.title: Adoption
features.text: Healthy, vaccinated animals matched with families who are ready for them.

features.title: Volunteer Walks
features.text: Weekend shifts for walking, cleaning and caring for animals in the shelter.

items.title: Someone Reports
items.text: A call or message tells us where an animal needs help.

items.title: We Reach And Treat
items.text: The rescue team brings the animal in and a vet checks it.

items.title: It Recovers
items.text: Food, rest and care at the shelter until the animal is healthy.

items.title: Home Or Release
items.text: Adopted by a family, or vaccinated and returned to its own area.

faq.q: What should I do if I find an injured animal?
faq.a: Call or message us with the exact location and a photo. Keep the animal calm and give it water while the team arrives.

faq.q: Can I adopt a dog or cat?
faq.a: Yes. We meet you first, then match you with an animal that suits your home. Every animal is vaccinated before it leaves.

faq.q: Do you give a receipt for donations?
faq.a: Yes. We issue a receipt for every donation and share how funds are used.

faq.q: Can I feed street animals myself?
faq.a: Yes. Ask us where feeding is needed so food reaches animals that are not already fed.
Message us. We will tell you the next walk, feeding round or shelter shift.

cta.title: Will You Stand With Them This Month?

about.title: About Our Rescue
paragraphs: {brand} began when a few neighbours started feeding and treating the street animals in their lane, and it grew into a rescue and adoption group.
We keep our work local, share how funds are used and treat every animal with patience and care.

testimonials.quote: They picked up an injured puppy within the hour and kept me updated until it was well.
We adopted from them and the home visit and vaccination records made us trust the process.
I walk the dogs every Sunday and see how carefully everything is organised.
